summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar now yields one Text object with clickable_ranges click spans (width moved to fifth position); Opacity layers blended color onto existing style so click metadata is kept; docs/reference/tabs.md added; tests appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py, plus new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py and tests/widgets/__init__.py. The layout resolver needed no change because its Edge protocol already declares size, min_size and fraction with the specified defaults. The sandbox demo was skipped as optional. Known limitation: an empty label has zero width, which the shared resolver treats as flexible. Tests were not executed, so they are verified only by reading.
